comment: The component may be described as enabling a “complete” patient history. No national longitudinal record is likely to be complete, particularly during transition or where providers remain unconnected.

citation.raw: §Lifelong Health Record, 2 p.156 l.Rationale and expected outcomes

anchor.note: p.156 read as the printed page, no line resolved; in the cited section

public.text: The component may be described as enabling a “complete” patient history. No national longitudinal record is likely to be complete, particularly during transition or where providers remain unconnected.
public.suggestedRevision: Use “available longitudinal health information” and require visible completeness, coverage, source, and freshness indicators so users do not mistake an incomplete record for a complete history.
